<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="25" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
  <rect x="330" y="16" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  <rect x="336" y="13" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  <rect x="342" y="10" width="3" height="15" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>

  <rect x="369" y="16" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  <rect x="353" y="15" width="11" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <path d="M306 20 Q311 14 316 20" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M309 23 Q311 20 313 23" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="311" cy="25" r="1.3" fill="#121212"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,59 24,66 31,73" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="66" x2="41" y2="66" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="55" y="72" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Payment method</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="24" y1="91" x2="366" y2="91" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <text x="24" y="128" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Your payment methods</text>
  <text x="24" y="153" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Choose how you’d like to pay for your orders.</text>

  <!-- Visa card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="26" y="174" width="340" height="91" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="24" y="172" width="340" height="91" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="42" y="194" width="52" height="34" rx="5" fill="#F2F4F8"/>
    <text x="68" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1D3A70">VISA</text>
    <text x="112" y="202" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Visa ending in 4242</text>
    <text x="112" y="224" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Expires 08/27</text>
    <rect x="321" y="201" width="20" height="20" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="326,211 330,215 337,207" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="336" y="233" width="8" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5DB329"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Mastercard card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="26" y="280" width="340" height="91" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="24" y="278" width="340" height="91" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="317" r="17" fill="#EC2A38"/>
    <circle cx="78" cy="317" r="17" fill="#FBBD00" opacity="0.92"/>
    <text x="112" y="308" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Mastercard ending in 8810</text>
    <text x="112" y="330" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Expires 11/26</text>
    <circle cx="332" cy="319" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#C7C7C7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="341,315 347,321 341,327" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Add payment method -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="392" width="342" height="58" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="421" x2="68" y2="421" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="60" y1="413" x2="60" y2="429" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="427" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Add payment method</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Payment settings -->
  <text x="24" y="493" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Payment settings</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="513" width="342" height="62" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="544" r="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <rect x="45" y="536" width="14" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="540" x2="59" y2="540" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="80" y="541" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Default payment method</text>
    <text x="80" y="560" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Visa ending in 4242</text>
    <polyline points="342,538 348,544 342,550" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="587" width="342" height="62" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="618" r="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="618" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="608" x2="52" y2="612" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="624" x2="52" y2="628" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="80" y="615" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Save cards for faster checkout</text>
    <text x="80" y="634" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Securely stored for future orders</text>
    <rect x="320" y="608" width="34" height="20" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="618" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Help note -->
  <rect x="24" y="672" width="342" height="57" rx="10" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="700" r="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <text x="48" y="705" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
  <text x="68" y="696" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#267347">Your payment details are protected</text>
  <text x="68" y="714" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#4B9460">We never share your card information.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <line x1="0" y1="748" x2="390" y2="748" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,774 49,765 59,774 59,786 52,786 52,778 46,778 46,786 39,786" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="49" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="117" y="766" width="20" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="117" y1="772" x2="137" y2="772" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="122" y1="762" x2="122" y2="769" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="762" x2="132" y2="769" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="127" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Orders</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="199" y="765" width="23" height="17" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polygon points="204,782 203,788 210,782" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <circle cx="206" cy="773" r="1.2" fill="#666666"/>
    <circle cx="211" cy="773" r="1.2" fill="#666666"/>
    <circle cx="216" cy="773" r="1.2" fill="#666666"/>
    <text x="211" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Community</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="302" cy="771" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="302" cy="784" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="302" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom gesture bar -->
  <rect x="143" y="829" width="104" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#121212"/>
</svg>
